% Macros reproduced from the user's note qft-C/513/symmetry_factors_orbit_stabilizer.tex (\vertexlegs, \tadpole, \feight)
\definecolor{leg}{RGB}{180,80,30}
\newcommand{\vertexlegs}[4]{% UL LL UR LR labels
  \draw[densely dashed, blue!60!black, line width=0.5pt] (0,0) circle (0.5);
  \foreach \a/\l in {135/#1,225/#2,45/#3,315/#4}{
    \fill[leg] (\a:0.5) circle (2pt);
    \node[leg, font=\footnotesize\bfseries] at (\a:0.28) {\l};}
}
% tadpole: x attaches at LL, y at LR, loop joins UL and UR
\newcommand{\tadpole}[4]{% labels: x-leg, y-leg, loop-left, loop-right
\scalebox{0.78}{\begin{tikzpicture}[baseline=(base), line width=0.7pt]
  \coordinate (base) at (0,-0.4);
  \fill (-1.8,-0.75) circle (1.8pt) node[left] {$x$};
  \fill (1.8,-0.75) circle (1.8pt) node[right] {$y$};
  \draw (-1.8,-0.75) -- (225:0.5);
  \draw (1.8,-0.75) -- (315:0.5);
  \draw (135:0.5) .. controls (-1.0,1.7) and (1.0,1.7) .. (45:0.5);
  \vertexlegs{#3}{#1}{#4}{#2}
\end{tikzpicture}}}
% x--y line times figure-eight: left loop joins UL,LL; right loop joins UR,LR
\newcommand{\feight}[4]{% labels: UL LL UR LR
\scalebox{0.78}{\begin{tikzpicture}[baseline=(base), line width=0.7pt]
  \coordinate (base) at (0,-0.4);
  \fill (-1.8,-1.25) circle (1.8pt) node[left] {$x$};
  \fill (1.8,-1.25) circle (1.8pt) node[right] {$y$};
  \draw (-1.8,-1.25) -- (1.8,-1.25);
  \draw (135:0.5) .. controls (-1.9,1.1) and (-1.9,-1.1) .. (225:0.5);
  \draw (45:0.5) .. controls (1.9,1.1) and (1.9,-1.1) .. (315:0.5);
  \vertexlegs{#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}
\end{tikzpicture}}}
